description: This file defines an Angular component for managing assets, including listing, searching, editing, creating, and deleting assets. It incorporates template HTML, styles, and logic for user interaction and API communication.

classes.name: AssetsPageComponent
classes.description: An Angular standalone component that provides UI and logic for managing assets within the application, including CRUD operations and search functionality.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called on component initialization; loads the asset list.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the asset list from the API, filtered by the search query.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Populates the form with data from the selected asset for editing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the form to its initial empty state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current form, creating or updating an asset via the API.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the selected asset after confirmation.
